verdict.rationale: Base44 offers a CLI (create, sync, deploy) and SDK that could be scripted from a terminal/CI environment, and backend is defined in code/config files intended to be machine-manageable, but there is no explicit documentation of headless/non-interactive auth, CI examples, or pipeline integration. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/CI authentication flow, explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or GitHub Actions integration, and confirmation the CLI supports headless execution without interactive login prompts.
